items.name: sugon-tokens
items.title: 曙光云品牌令牌 tokens.css
items.description: Sugon Cloud brand design tokens as plain CSS variables: brand red #C8161D, gray/white neutrals, type scale, radius, spacing, shadows and button sizes. Writes src/styles/sugon-tokens.css.
items.docs: 已写入 src/styles/sugon-tokens.css。请在入口 CSS（如 src/index.css）最顶部加：@import "./styles/sugon-tokens.css";（相对路径按你的项目调整；用 Tailwind v4 时放在 @import "tailwindcss" 之前）。

items.name: sugon-brand-kit
items.title: 曙光云 sugon-brand-kit（AI 设计技能 + 令牌）
items.description: Agent Skill (SKILL.md + DESIGN.md + tokens.css + components.css) for Codex / Cursor / Copilot / Gemini CLI (.agents/skills) and Claude Code (.claude/skills), plus tokens and the plain-CSS snippets at src/styles/.
items.docs: 技能已写入 .agents/skills/sugon-brand-kit/ 与 .claude/skills/sugon-brand-kit/（含 components.css）。令牌写入 src/styles/sugon-tokens.css，片段写入 src/styles/sugon-components.css。请在入口 CSS 顶部依次加：@import "./styles/sugon-tokens.css"; @import "./styles/sugon-components.css";。按钮 / 卡片 / 表单用 sugon-btn、sugon-card、sugon-input 等类，不要另写一套。想让规则常驻生效，可再装可选项 sugon-brand-rules。

items.name: sugon-brand-rules
items.title: 曙光云常驻品牌规则（可选）
items.description: Optional always-on pointer rules: Cursor .cursor/rules/sugon-brand.mdc and GitHub Copilot .github/instructions/sugon-brand.instructions.md (both scoped to UI files). Never touches AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md.
items.docs: 已写入 .cursor/rules/sugon-brand.mdc 与 .github/instructions/sugon-brand.instructions.md（只对 UI 文件生效，指向 sugon-brand-kit 技能，请先装 sugon-brand-kit）。需要 Codex / Claude Code 也常驻遵守时，请手动把 https://github.com/tao66175545-boop/sugon-cloud-skillui/blob/main/registry/rules/AGENTS.snippet.md 中的一节追加到你的 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md；本命令不会修改这两个文件。
